summary: Spawns a spark particle at a collision contact point. Computes the contact magnitude and point from the incoming normal and position vectors, allocates a slot from the circular buffer owned by this, sizes the spark from a 256-entry trig table indexed by a rotating byte counter, computes a collision normal (with a fallback when the feature query fails), writes position, velocity and magnitude into the slot, then publishes the slot through three array/flag-flagging helpers. Runs when the contact magnitude is at least 1.0 and the slot counter at this + 88 is positive. Called by the collision effect dispatch (004ce3e0).

operations.description: Compute the contact magnitude v39 as the square root of the sum of the three squared components of the direction vector a4.
Emit a particle only when the magnitude is at least 1.0 and the slot counter at this + 88 (field 0x58) is positive.
Allocate a particle slot from the circular buffer owned by this.
Initialize the slot position: slot[2] = a2 and slot[3] = a2 + the slot's prior value at slot[7].

Compute the spark size v13 as (trig-table value indexed by the post-incrementing byte counter times 64.0 plus 190.0) times a5, store it in slot[10], and rescale it by v39 divided by the threshold at this + 72 (field 0x48) when v39 is below that threshold.
Store the caller-supplied integer a7 into the slot's dword 17.
Compute the contact point as a3 plus a4 scaled by the value at this + 76 (field 0x4C) divided by the magnitude v39.
Store the contact point vector components into slot[11..13] after the normal computation completes.
Store the velocity vector as a4 scaled by 0.1 into slot[14..16] and the magnitude v39 into slot[26].
Compute the collision normal from the feature data at dbl_7C9360 and the contact point vector; on failure write a fallback normal into slot[21..23] and adjust the stored slot[12] component.
Set the texture layer flag on the slot's backing array using the stored slot[11..13] values as parameters.
Set an array element flag with bounds checking using the values at this + 12 (field 0xC), this + 16 (field 0x10) and this + 20 (field 0x14) as parameters.
Write the sentinel value 0xFFFFFF into the bounds-checked array entry for the slot.
